summary: Iteration 4 (photos, payouts, fee-only totals, geocoding, courier alerts). Backend: 12/12 new tests pass (test_photo_upload_iter5.py 6/6, test_fees_payouts_geo.py 6/6). The full suite gave 56/61. The 5 failures come from outdated older tests that still expect totals based on order amount, or that upload a PNG under 200 bytes. These are not app regressions. Frontend (390x844): every requested flow passed. Owner order detail shows delivery-proof-card with a working delivery-photo image (naturalWidth 120) and delivery-note-text. Order cards show card-photo-N and card-note-N. route-card shows trip-point-dest. Gestión > Repartidores shows 'Por pagar: 3,50 € (1 envíos)'; the Pagar button (44px high) opens pay-courier-sheet; confirm sets the amount to 0,00 €, hides the button and shows the toast 'Pago registrado'. Labels 'Envíos de hoy' / 'Total de envíos' are correct, and the courier today card shows pending-payout. Courier alert: 'Nueva tarea asignada: #1264' appeared 4.6s after the API assign; 'Tarea cancelada o retirada: #1264' appeared 1.2s after the API cancel. No deprecated packages found (expo-audio is used).

minor.issue: Race condition: pending_for() computes the amount, then update_many marks ALL delivered unpaid orders as paid. An order delivered between those two calls is marked paid without being counted in the payout amount. Fix: collect the order _ids first, then update_many({_id: {$in: ids}}) and compute the amount from those docs.

issues: Plural grammar: '(1 envíos)', '1 tareas entregadas', '1 activas'. Use singular forms when count == 1.
The summary card shows the same number twice: 'Total de envíos 144,50 €' and the sub-metric 'Envíos 144,50 €'. The sub-metric is redundant now that totals use fees only.
The Mapa tab only shows courier markers, no delivery-destination markers. The destination icon only appears in the order-detail route-card. Confirm this matches the user's request (2).

action_items: Update the outdated regression tests to the new fee-only semantics: test_courier_history.py:83 and :169, test_geo_courier_report.py:116, test_reports_payment_photo.py:142. Also make the _png() fixture in test_reports_payment_photo.py produce at least 200 bytes (line 192 is now rejected with 'La foto llegó vacía').
Make the payout atomic with respect to the exact orders summed (see backend minor issue).
Add refetchInterval or refetchOnFocus to the ['payouts'] query in manage.tsx so 'Por pagar' updates while the owner is on the screen.
Fix the plural grammar in the courier rows and the pay sheet; remove the duplicate 'Envíos' sub-metric in Reportes.
critical_code_review_comments: courier.tsx alert diffing is sound: there is no alert on the first load, and orders the courier delivers themselves are excluded through the delivered set. On web, sound depends on the browser's autoplay policy; vibration only works on native.

test_delivery_api.py:176 sets Carlos's location to Buenos Aires (-34.6,-58.38), so the courier TripMap zooms out to a world view. This is test-data pollution, but consider ignoring a stale courier location (old location_at) in map bounds.
GET /orders/{id}/photo authenticates with a JWT in the query string; the token can end up in logs. Acceptable for Image sources, but a short-lived signed URL would be better.

success_rate.backend: 100% of new feature tests (12/12); 56/61 of the full suite (5 outdated assertions)
